failed_payment.answer: If a payment is marked failed, check its final status in your bank or payment app. If the amount was debited, reversal handling and timing depend on the bank and payment method. Contact the merchant or payment provider through its official support channel with the transaction reference. Do not share a card number, CVV, PIN, or OTP.

debited_without_success.answer: If your account was debited but the payment or order did not complete, check the final payment status in your bank or payment app and avoid repeated attempts while it is unresolved. Reversal handling and timing depend on the bank and payment method. Contact the merchant or payment provider through its official support channel with the transaction reference. Never share a card number, CVV, PIN, password, or OTP.

pending_payment.answer: A pending payment has not reached a final status. Check the bank or payment app before trying again to avoid duplicate attempts. If it remains pending, contact the merchant or payment provider through its official support channel with the transaction reference. Do not share a card number, CVV, PIN, or OTP.

refund.answer: For a refund, first confirm with the merchant that it was approved and ask for its reference. Refund processing time depends on the merchant, bank, and payment method. If it does not appear after the timeframe they provide, contact the merchant or bank through an official channel. Never share a card number, CVV, PIN, or OTP.

payment_faq.answer: For a payment question, check the final status and reference in your bank or payment app, then contact the merchant or payment provider through its official support channel if you need account-specific help. This demo cannot inspect individual payments. Never share a card number, CVV, PIN, password, or OTP in chat.

troubleshooting.answer: For a payment issue, check your internet connection and the final status in your bank or payment app. Avoid repeated attempts while a payment is pending. For account-specific help, contact the merchant or payment provider through its official support channel. This demo cannot access individual payment records. Never share a card number, CVV, PIN, password, or OTP.

complaint.answer: To raise a complaint, contact the merchant or payment provider through its official support channel and include the transaction reference and a description of the issue. Do not include card numbers, CVVs, PINs, passwords, or OTPs. This demo cannot file complaints, access individual payment records, or process payments or refunds.
